data.value: Could not complete this operation. Check the file format, file access, and storage space. No credentials are included in backup files.

data.name: Busy
data.value: Finish active work, pending approvals, or settings changes first.

data.name: Exported
data.value: Backup saved. It contains no connection tokens or authorization settings.

data.name: Restored
data.value: Preferences restored. Chat is disconnected. Check the CLI and workspace, enter connection tokens, and configure authorized users before reconnecting. The original settings file is retained locally as settings-original-before-restore.json. Keep that private recovery file on this PC; do not share it.

data.name: Cleared
data.value: Selected local data removed. Chat remains disconnected.

data.name: TrustWorkspace
data.value: I trust the workspace shown above and want to restore it.

data.name: RestoreNotice
data.value: This replaces agent and connection preferences. Tokens, permitted users/threads, automatic connection, automatic execution and attachment approvals are not restored. CLI arguments return to provider defaults; custom arguments must be entered again. Without the checkbox below, the working folder stays unset. Check that the CLI location is trustworthy.

data.name: ClearNotice
data.value: This permanently removes only the selected app data. Connections stop first. Files in your workspace, chat-server posts, and histories maintained by agent CLIs are unaffected. Usage totals are kept unless selected here.
